rows.title: The effect of probiotic supplementation on perceived stress and bowel function in healthy young adults: evidence from a randomized controlled trial in Makkah.
rows.focus: Randomized trial in 66 healthy young adults with moderate-to-high perceived stress. Thirty days of Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG was associated with a greater reduction in perceived stress than no intervention; bowel outcomes did not differ. Larger placebo-controlled trials are needed.
